approvers: Developer / main contractor (subcontract package), project manager
reason: I pay about €12 a m² all-in today with film and tape and my own labour, and this is €19 a m² plus a 50% deposit up front. The subcontract package decides what protection is used, and nobody has asked me for a coating.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and I am left carrying the damage claim on top of a price 60% higher than film.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet or board with tape, applied and removed by my own crew.
would_change_my_mind: ACHV or the applicator accepting written liability for any frame or glass damage on removal, plus a price near €12 a m² or the developer specifying it and paying for it.
